currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only;no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected elevated facade/side roof: warm limestone, two open square belfries with green bells, pale pyramidal roofs and base balustrades, additional exposed bell frame in front of the right pyramid, three front clock faces on that tower, central columned balcony/door/arched upper window and triangular gable, pale metal nave roof and repeated sloping buttress ribs over low side roofs. Large dome behind belongs to another building and is excluded.

Inspected closer full front: single tall recessed wooden portal below column-supported balcony/balustrade, flanking shallow blind arched niches, upper arched window, restrained pilasters/cornices, central triangular gable and small dark relief field, three painted clock/calendar dials on the right tower, recessed belfry arches/green bells and right rooftop bell frame. Exact carved coats of arms, dial text and sculpture omitted.
